references.text: The Lord was angry with Moses and Aaron at the waters of Meribah because of the people's rebellion, and He refused to let them lead the people into the promised land.
The Lord explains that Moses will not enter the land because he was disobedient at the waters of Meribah in the wilderness of Zin.
Moses tells how the Lord also became angry with him because of the people, and that he would not be allowed to enter the land.
Moses repeats that the Lord was angry with him because of what the people said, and swore that he would not cross the Jordan.
Moses acknowledges that the Lord has said he will not go over the Jordan.
The Lord shows Moses the land but confirms that he will not cross over into it.
The psalm describes how the people provoked the Lord's anger at the waters of Meribah, and this judgment fell on Moses because of them.
